result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner uses white text on a very light green background, creating poor contrast that makes the offer text hard to read.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' banner has white/light text on a very pale green background, resulting in very low contrast. The description text ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is especially hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (e.g., dark green or black) for the banner text, or darken the banner background to ensure sufficient contrast.
